<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Inquiry" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/transaction-data-inquiry">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Inquiry">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Participant_INQ" targetRef="Start_Request" messageRef="Msg_DataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Transmission" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="Participant_INQ" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="SendTask_Reject" targetRef="Participant_INQ" messageRef="Msg_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP examination of data request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Request" name="Request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckRequest</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Request" messageRef="Msg_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckRequest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToOutcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome_Split" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToOutcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Admissible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TransmitData" name="Transmit data to INQ" messageRef="Msg_DataTransmission">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Admissible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TransmitEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Reject" name="Reject request to INQ" messageRef="Msg_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TransmitEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckRequest" sourceRef="Start_Request" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Admissible" name="Request admissible" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Request rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransmitEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="End_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_Reject" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states a sequence of steps in which one participant transmits a request to another participant, the receiving participant checks it, and then gives a reply whose content depends on the outcome of that check: Model a start event before the first step of the sequence and an end event after the final step, and connect every described step, including the reply task that follows the check, with sequence flows in the order the description gives. Do not leave the first step without an incoming start event, do not drop the reply task, and do not leave the check or the reply without the flow that links it to the next step.
rules.situation: the description states a sequence of steps in which one participant transmits a request to another participant, the receiving participant checks it, and then gives a reply whose content depends on the outcome of that check

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant evaluates a request received from another participant, and the reply to the sender then depends on the result of that evaluation, with alternative replies such as acceptance or rejection: Model the evaluation as a task in the receiving participant. Follow it with a separate reply task in that same participant, which is not merged into the evaluation task and does not end the flow directly. Route the flow after the evaluation through a decision gateway with one outgoing branch per stated result, and let each branch lead to the reply that the description gives for that result.
rules.situation: the description says a participant evaluates a request received from another participant, and the reply to the sender then depends on the result of that evaluation, with alternative replies such as acceptance or rejection

rules.instruction: When the description lists several activities in a stated order, with transitional phrases such as 'Next', 'then', or 'as soon as', and one activity is followed by a later activity or check that the description places after it: Model each described activity as its own task, and connect each one to the activity the description places immediately after it with a sequence flow. Do not leave a described successor without an incoming flow from its predecessor, even when the predecessor is a simple selection or a task that follows another task. Where the description adds a later step that follows an earlier one, add that flow as well, so that every stated step is reachable in the order given.
rules.situation: the description lists several successive steps, each performed by a party after the previous step, and the steps are stated in a fixed order

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant checks a request received from another participant, and the reply to that requester then depends on the outcome of the check, with alternative results stated: Model the check as a task in the receiving participant. Follow it with one reply task in that same participant that sends the reply to the requester, and name the stated alternative results in that reply task's label. Do not place an exclusive gateway directly after the check that sends each outcome to its own end event, so the reply to the requester stays an explicit task in the receiving participant.
rules.situation: the description says a participant checks a request received from another participant, and the reply to that requester then depends on the outcome of the check, with alternative results stated
